title: Powdered Snow Warning
description: PSW Highlights Powdered Snow with Red Borders.
body:
# ❄️ Powdered Snow Warning

> Powdered snow now has a red stripe on its sides, making it instantly distinguishable from regular snow before you fall through.

---

## What it does

Powdered snow blocks display a **red warning band** across their side textures. At a glance, even from a distance, you can tell powdered snow apart from regular snow without hovering over it or guessing.

![example image of powdered snow with texturepack on](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1c77246daae4bd5dbf1005d9080aad2f65fb5796.png) |

**Key changes:**
- Red stripe added to the **side faces** of powdered snow
- Top and bottom textures remain **vanilla-faithful**
- Stripe is visible at standard render distances

---

## Features

| | |
|---|---|
| 👁️ **Instant recognition** | The red stripe is readable at a distance, even at lower render distances. |
| 🧩 **No mods required** | Works as a standalone resource pack: no Fabric, Forge, or Quilt needed. |
| 🎮 **Zero performance cost** | Pure texture swap with no impact on frame rate or world loading. |
| 🖼️ **Vanilla-faithful** | Visible from all sides.

---

## Installation

1. Download the `.zip` from the releases section — **do not unzip it**.
2. Open Minecraft → **Options → Resource Packs → Open Pack Folder**.
3. Move the `.zip` file directly into the `resourcepacks` folder.
4. Back in Minecraft, click the pack to activate it and hit **Done**. No restart required.

---

## Compatibility

- ✅ Java Edition **1.19.4 and above**
- ✅ Compatible with other resource packs
- ✅ Works with OptiFine and Iris
- ❌ Bedrock Edition is not supported
